scripts.manual-deploy: npm run build && powershell -NoProfile -Command "$repo = git config --get remote.origin.url; if (-not $repo) { $repo = 'https://github.com/zhourui9813/zhourui9813.github.io.git' }; if (Test-Path 'dist/.git') { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force 'dist/.git' }; Push-Location dist; git init; git add -A; git commit --allow-empty -m 'Deploy'; git branch -M gh-pages; git remote remove origin 2>$null; git remote add origin $repo; git push -f origin gh-pages; Pop-Location"
